scratch_root: the seed checkpoints and the dataset root live under --scratch (the container overlay on a kernel), never beside the record: the block is ~38 GiB and the working mount is 20 GB
what_this_is: The registered campaign's null queue (section 5.14), one seed per chip on a TPU, trained with run_v0_session and published with publish_seed - the same path the T4 null queue runs. It differs from that queue in exactly one field, named in `dtype`: the session's registered dtypes are fp32 and fp16, and fp16 on a TPU needs an autocast and scaler path no record here shows working.
